title: Where the cut's ledger is read from, and what is read before a branch records anything
situation: 0132 reads what is frozen from the branch's recorded tip, the ledger's entries included, and has the frozen visible freeze checks rebound so their project records its ledger. Two frozen checks stand against that. The visible freeze checks keep the ledger unrecorded, and in this repository only the architect's commit may change them, so their rebinding waits for the architect. The held-out checks keep a project that has recorded nothing at all: its cuts, examples and ledger exist only in its working copy, and they still expect the journal to refuse the lead and admit the architect. Read strictly, a branch with no recorded ledger has no open cut, and a branch with no recorded tip has no examples, so the lead's supersession of a frozen concept would be admitted in both. 0133 puts moving the ledger away and an integration written by hand outside the freeze.
decision: Recommended, and built this round as the reversible default: the ledger is cratylus's own append-only record and is read where cratylus keeps it; tampering with it stays outside the freeze, as 0133 says. The examples, checks and the files the checks use are read from the branch's recorded tip, never from a working copy. Where the branch has recorded nothing yet, there is no record to contradict the working copy, and they are read from it. Every frozen check stands unchanged. If the architect rules instead that the ledger is read from the tip, the architect rebinds the visible freeze checks and says what a project that has recorded nothing reads, and the next round switches where the ledger is read from.
consequences: Accepted: the cut's in-scope working-copy routes close (a retagged example, a dropped import, a working-copy mention meeting the dispatch rule) with no change to any frozen check. Rejected: the architect's commit rebinds the visible freeze checks, the held-out project's case is ruled, and the record point and the journal read the ledger from the tip.
